prompt: Build the Resibo Scanner page. I need the page route at /app/(app)/(features)/resibo/page.tsx that fetches the user's recent receipts from Supabase, a ScanButton client component that opens the camera and uploads to Supabase Storage then calls POST /api/resibo/scan, and a ReceiptCard component that displays the OCR results with vendor name, date, total in pesos, and a confidence badge. Include loading.tsx and error.tsx. All user-facing text should be Taglish.

assertions.text: page.tsx is a Server Component (no 'use client' directive)
Money is displayed using centavos-to-peso conversion, not raw centavos
User-facing text contains Taglish (mix of Filipino and English)
Uses brand color tokens (honey, teal, ink, card) not raw hex or default Tailwind colors
Touch targets have min-h-[44px] or min-h-touch
